name: Shinohara Himeko
source:
Often called “Onee-san” (big sister) by her younger sister and friends, Himeko is a car-loving enthusiast with a bright and brisk type of personality. Cheerful and full of energy, no one ever expected that she would one day become a patient in the same ward she had spent so much time volunteering at. Ever since her time in the hospice as a patient began, she became cold and harsh towards [url=https://vndb.org/c6579]her sister[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c33254]her best friend[/url], but she still loved them immensely. Before she became ill, she was a very active, tomboyish girl who held a great love for cars and knew a great deal about them and the roads they drive on.

[spoiler]Despite what she says, she is actually religious, and always cares for her family and friends. Maintaining a bright and optimistic appearance throughout the game, only at the end, her inner side is shown as she questioned God and cried with [url=https://vndb.org/c939]Setsumi[/url] by her side. At the end, she managed to bid farewell to the girl with a smile. She is very understanding and mature despite what she shows, and holds a great pain in her heart about [url=https://vndb.org/c36414]one girl[/url] whom she once took care of as a helper.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Narcissu:_Side_2nd]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.neechin.net/narcissu2/133/story-and-cast]Neechin.net[/url]]
